description.value:
Two further Force-Empowered Tech effects become available to you: Harmonic Synthesis and Conservation of Energy.

Harmonic Synthesis. When you cast a force power using your action, you may spend your bonus action to gain resistance to tech power damage until the start of your next turn; if you instead cast a tech power with your action, you may gain resistance to force power damage in the same way.

Conservation of Energy. When a tech power you cast drops a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you may retroactively reduce that power's force point cost to 0, requiring no action.
